Oferecemos empréstimos com segurança e transparência para quem deseja quitar dívidas maiores, investir em algo ou realizar um sonho. Com o propósito transformar soluções financeiras em sorrisos! E o que nos torna especiais?  Somos apaixonados pelo sorriso:  Buscamos as melhores experiências para os nossos clientes, valorizamos as pessoas e somos apaixonados pela empresa. Somos inovadores e buscamos simplicidade:  Testamos, aprendemos e pensamos sempre em melhorias contínuas. Somos flexíveis e promovemos mudanças:  Cultivamos a adaptabilidade como virtude, incentivando e promovendo constantes transformações para alcançar o melhor de cada jornada. Somos guiados por dados:  Os nossos objetivos são claros, se não podemos medir, não podemos fazer. Somos direcionados pela eficiência e aproveitamos ao máximo os recursos disponíveis.  Nossas vagas são destinadas à todas as pessoas! Sem distinção de gênero, raça, cor, idade, orientação sexual ou etnia. Responsabilidades e atribuições:  Identificar dores, gaps e oportunidades nos produtos financeiros a partir de dados e feedbacks internos e externos; Elaborar e executar estratégias para evolução dos produtos em parceria com áreas como Comercial, Marketing, Tecnologia, Dados e etc; Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos produtos, propondo ações para melhoria contínua; Realizar análises quantitativas e qualitativas para embasar decisões e tracionar novas iniciativas; Realizar benchmarkings e estudos de mercado para embasar estratégias e posicionamento; Apoiar o desenho e acompanhamento das jornadas dos produtos, buscando a melhor experiência para o cliente; Conduzir alinhamentos recorrentes com stakeholders internos para garantir o sucesso das ações propostas; Trabalhar em parceria com a área de dados para cruzamento de informações e validação de hipóteses.  Requisitos obrigatórios:  Experiência anterior como Analista de Produtos, preferencialmente em produtos financeiros; Conhecimento avançado em Excel (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos, modelagem de dados, etc.); Conhecimento avançado em SQL (extração, tratamento e análise de dados); Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica para transformar dados em ações; Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento com diversas áreas; Experiência em análise de KPIs e métricas de produtos; Capacidade de organização e priorização de demandas em um ambiente dinâmico. Deliver clear reports and presentations explaining assumptions, modeling choices, limitations, and design implications.  Requirements  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. Strong understanding of FEM fundamentals, with hands-on experience. Ability to explain model behavior and link results to underlying physics. Experience in test-based model calibration/validation and correlating simulation with experimental data. Knowledge of fatigue analysis and durability assessment. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for data processing, automation, and custom tool development. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Proactive, self-directed learner who goes beyond the brief to resolve issues. Advanced English level. Live in or have availability to move to São Paulo.  Bonus points  Expertise in vibration and structural dynamics. Experience in optimization, robust/stochastic design, and uncertainty quantification. Empresa está contratando Executivo Comercial Senior - 99 Food em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Executivo Comercial Senior - 99 Food Job Locations BR-SP-Sao Paulo ID   Company Overview Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. #LI-Hybrid Team Overview A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99. Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo. Role Responsibilities O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário. Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas. Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.  Role Qualifications Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas. 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo). Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender enquanto trabalha em um ambiente de startup em ritmo acelerado, com mudanças constantes e metas desafiadoras. Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais. Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação. Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários. Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas. Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.  EEO Statement Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão  Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. Reconheço que, antes de enviar esta inscrição, li e aceitei o Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos, disponível em  Options Aplicar para este emprego online Share Email this job to a friend Refer Application FAQs Software Powered by iCIMS   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Junior Product Owner - Brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Junior Product Owner - Brazil em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About North Star Network  North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.  Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.  We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.  About the Role  At North Star Network, we are looking for a Junior Product Owner for our Brazilian Business Unit to support our Product team in delivering high-quality, business-driven digital products.  This role is ideal for someone organized, curious, and eager to grow in Product Management, with a strong interest in digital products, user experience, and data-informed decision-making.  You will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Tech, UX, QA, and business stakeholders to help translate business and user needs into clear, actionable product requirements, ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement across our platforms.  Key Responsibilities  1. Backlog Management & Specification   Assist in maintaining a structured and organized product backlog.  Draft initial user stories and acceptance criteria based on guidance and documented user or business needs.  Support refinement sessions with Tech, UX, and stakeholders to clarify requirements.  Help assess and communicate feature priorities according to business objectives and constraints.    2. Sprint Preparation & Delivery Support   Support backlog grooming sessions by preparing tickets and ensuring required details are available.  Clarify straightforward questions from the development team, escalating complex topics to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Help validate completed stories by checking alignment with acceptance criteria.  Flag potential requirement gaps, risks, or dependencies to the Product Owner or Product Manager early.    3. Product Quality & Feedback Loop   Contribute to ensuring user stories lead to high-quality product increments.  Collaborate with QA by supporting test case preparation and helping review defects.  Collect basic user feedback, operational insights, or data points to support iteration.  Uphold consistency in product behavior and user experience by reporting inconsistencies.    4. Stakeholder Communication   Assist in maintaining communication between stakeholders and the development team.  Help prepare status updates, release notes, or documentation for internal stakeholders.  Communicate small updates or clarifications, while escalating major decisions to the Product Owner or Product Manager.  Ensure continuous alignment with the Product Owner and Product Manager on prioritization and scope.    What We’re Looking For   1–3 years of experience in a Product, Project, Business Analyst, or Tech-related role (or relevant internships).  Strong organizational and communication skills.  Ability to structure information clearly and write concise product documentation.  Basic understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies and product development cycles.  Analytical mindset with an interest in data, user behavior, and business impact.  Comfortable working with cross‑functional, fully remote teams.  Fluency in English (written and spoken); French or other languages are a plus.  Interest in digital media, sports, or iGaming is a strong advantage.    What We Offer   A hands‑on Product role with strong learning and growth opportunities.  Exposure to international, high‑traffic digital products in sports and betting media.  100% remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones.  A multicultural, fast‑growing team passionate about sports, data, and digital innovation.  A culture of autonomy, ownership, and continuous improvement.  Competitive salary.    Ready to Join Us?  If you’re eager to grow in Product Management, enjoy working at the intersection of business, tech, and user experience, and want to contribute to impactful digital products we’d love to hear from you.  Apply now and help shape the next generation of NSN’s products.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Field Enablement Manager (LATAM)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Field Enablement Manager (LATAM) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

The Team  Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog’s Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.  As Datadog continues to invest in LATAM, this role represents a foundational hire—helping establish how enablement shows up locally while staying tightly connected to our global enablement ecosystem.  The Opportunity  Datadog is growing quickly across Latin America, and we’re looking for our first Field Enablement Manager based in LATAM  to support this momentum. This role will be responsible for delivering ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement  for our Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM—particularly for sellers and CSMs based in Brazil and Mexico .  In addition, you’ll support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America  (e.g., Boston, Denver, Atlanta) who sell into LATAM accounts. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the field, ensuring global enablement programs land effectively in the local context—across language, culture, sales motion, and market dynamics.  This role is ideal for someone who thrives as an independent operator, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement to meet regional needs while staying aligned with global standards. This role will report into the our global Field Enablement team based in New York City and continue partnering with Field Enablement Managers globally across all regions and segments.  What You’ll Do   Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding  for Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM.  Partner closely with Sales and CS leaders in Brazil and Mexico  to understand performance needs and provide targeted enablement support.  Support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America who sell to LATAM customers.  Adapt and localize globally developed enablement programs to ensure relevance across language, culture, market context, and regional sales motions .  Design and facilitate reinforcement activities (e.g., role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that help sellers apply core concepts in real customer scenarios.  Collaborate closely with the Curriculum team  to share field insights, provide feedback on program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of global content.  Track participation, collect feedback, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to assess enablement impact and identify opportunities for improvement.  Build trusted relationships with Sales, Customer Success, and cross‑functional partners to diagnose challenges and recommend appropriate enablement interventions.  Act as a regional connector—surfacing LATAM‑specific insights back to global enablement teams to help shape future programs.    Who You Are   3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role.  Experience supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; regional or international experience is a strong plus.  Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English  (required).  Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions.  Solid business acumen and comfort working with performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions.  Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented—you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners.  Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Command of the Message.  Foundational understanding of Datadog’s core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.  Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing region.  Scrappy and pragmatic—you enjoy building from the ground up and iterating as you go.  Willing and able to travel approximately 30%  across Latin America and North America.    Why This Role Matters  As Datadog’s first Field Enablement hire in LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how enablement supports our sellers and Customer Success teams in the region. You’ll help ensure our global programs translate into local impact—accelerating ramp, improving confidence, and enabling teams to succeed with customers across a rapidly growing market.  Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people‑first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Job description Sobre a Rodobens:  Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles. Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade. Por que a Rodobens?  Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor. A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação  Consórcio  A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais. Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor. Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade! Main responsibilities Estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em Consórcios . Se você já possui experiência na área ou deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um dos segmentos mais tradicionais e estratégicos da Rodobens, esta é a oportunidade ideal para se conectar conosco. Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras posições alinhadas às suas competências e ao seu potencial de crescimento. A Vestacy é uma empresa independente (originada do carve-out da Reckitt) com um propósito claro: transformar casas em lares. Com quase 3.000 colaboradores em mais de 20 países, vemos cada pessoa como um Fundador, com poder para tomar decisões importantes e moldar o futuro. Cuidamos do nosso negócio com a mesma dedicação que você tem pelo seu lar: com propósito, paixão e energia. Aqui, você encontrará espaço para liderar e inovar. Juntos, estamos construindo algo extraordinário. A equipe de Digital Activation Hub da Vestacy é altamente especializada e dinâmica, atuando para conectar a estratégia de marketing à execução nas plataformas digitais. Estamos empenhados em impulsionar cada vez mais a inovação digital das nossas marcas, utilizando nossa expertise para garantir campanhas de alta performance. Sobre a oportunidade Nesta posição como Gerente de Retail Media, você atuará em estratégias para impulsionar a presença digital das nossas marcas em plataformas estratégicas como Amazon Ads, Mercado Livre (Mercado Ads), Google Ads, entre outros. Além disso, você irá colaborar com stakeholders internos e agências parceiras para garantir que nossas campanhas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, planejando ativações de Retail Media de forma estratégica e executando com excelência. Esta posição abrange tanto estratégia quanto execução, abarcando desde o planejamento de ativações de mídia digital até a construção de campanhas em tempo real para maximizar resultados para as marcas e o negócio. Se você gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, orientado(a) a dados e é apaixonado(a) por inovação em retail media no mercado de consumo massivo, queremos te conhecer! Suas responsabilidades: Planejamento estratégico e tático (30% do papel) Transformar insights de marca e audiência em planos de táticos de retail media e paid search, alinhados aos objetivos da campanha e às capacidades das plataformas. Desenvolver calendários mensais e trimestrais de ativação, considerando períodos promocionais, lançamentos de produtos e eventos específicos de cada varejista. Contribuir para a criação e atualização de guias de plataforma, incorporando aprendizados, melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades. Apoiar na definição e distribuição de orçamento para otimizar investimento por plataforma, produto e período.  Execução e otimização (70% do papel) Gerenciar a execução end-to-end de campanhas em Retail Media (Search & Display) e Paid Search (Google Ads, Meta), garantindo lançamentos no prazo e configurações corretas. Monitorar diariamente a performance das campanhas, ajustando em tempo real para melhorar eficiência e atingir os KPIs. Implementar melhores práticas de cada plataforma em segmentação, lançamentos e formatos criativos. Explorar ferramentas e betas para aumentar a efetividade e manter-se atualizado(a) nas tendências de retail media. Coordenar com times internos (marca, analytics, finanças) e com agências parceiras externas para alinhar execução com objetivos de marketing. Realizar testes A/B e pilotos para identificar táticas escaláveis e melhorar produtividade. Reportar métricas-chave (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e gerar insights.  Estamos em busca das seguintes vivências: Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação Social e afins; Experiência sólida na gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Amazon Ads e Mercado Livre, Google Ads, etc. Conhecimento profundo em retail media, KPIs (ROAS, conversão, share of voice) e otimização de campanhas. Capacidade de analisar e interpretar dados/KPIs para transformá-los em decisões estratégicas. Vivência com definição estratégias de retail media, incluindo calendários sazonais, alinhamento promocional e segmentação de audiência. Experiência colaborando com times multifuncionais (marca, vendas, analytics) e agências externas. Domínio de ferramentas como DSPs, dashboards analíticos, Excel e PowerPoint. Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: interesse em se manter atualizado sobre tendências e novidades em retail media. Inglês avançado para conexão com times regionais e globais.  Outras informações: - Modelo híbrido (3x2); Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, acreditamos que as melhores equipes são construídas como grandes lares: com bases sólidas e espaço para crescer. Se você se identifica com nosso propósito, te encorajamos a se candidatar em nossas oportunidades, mesmo que você não atenda a todos os requisitos. Todos os candidatos serão avaliados independentemente de idade, habilidades, origem, identidade ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei. Juntos, criaremos um espaço onde todos possam crescer. Disclaimer: a Vestacy não realiza cobranças para a participação em processos seletivos. Caso receba alguma mensagem solicitando pagamento, não responda e entre em contato conosco através das redes sociais ou SAC. Atuar na resolução de problemas críticos do dia a dia (conflitos de carga, problemas em aplicativos, gargalos de saída). Alimentar dashboards e realizar consultas básicas em SQL para gerar relatórios de acompanhamento. Identificar padrões simples de falha e sugerir ajustes imediatos ao parceiro. Em nosso formato de atuação a nossa proposta é que você trabalhe por projeto (PJ) , com carga horária flexível e tempo determinado. Queremos dar oportunidades de carreiras para todas as pessoas que desejem trabalhar conosco. Strong understanding of business operations and strategic priorities, with the ability to participate in high-level discussions and support informed decision-making.  Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end projects, ensuring delivery within established scope, timelines, and quality standards.  Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and operate under pressure in a dynamic environment.  Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft high-quality correspondence, reports, and presentations.  Bilingual proficiency in English and Portuguese is required; Spanish is a strong must.  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Power BI) and project management tools, with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new systems. Strong initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently while maintaining high performance in a fast-paced environment. Colaborar na definição de critérios de especificação das matérias primas e ingredientes para projetos de inovação, otimização, manutenção e renovação de portfólio, incluindo os requisitos regulatórios e avaliando oportunidades de enquadramento de regulamentos técnicos ou documentos relevantes (Monografias / Padrões).  Acompanhar e reportar publicações oficiais de legislações, elaborando relatórios de aplicabilidade, ações necessárias e acompanhamento de prazos. Elaborar documentos de textos legais para inclusão em embalagens (Copydeck), avaliar riscos regulatórios, documentar e compartilhar informações com times de marketing e de qualidade. Realizar verificação de textos legais em artes ou peças de publicidade apontando inconsistências ou riscos, com suporte da liderança de P&D.  Em conjunto com as equipes de desenvolvimento de embalagens e de desenvolvimento de produtos, avaliar soluções tecnológicas e funcionais para entrega de um produto viável.  Colaborar na transferência de conhecimento técnico contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de equipes de produção, qualidade, marketing, atendimento ao consumidor e potenciais clientes / parceiros, através da elaboração de material técnico para treinamento.  Contribuir para estudos de avaliação de consumidor e de concorrência, acompanhando tendências de mercado, oportunidades e correções.  Quando solicitado e em conformidade com os objetivos e posicionamento do negócio, participa de eventos oferecidos pela empresa ou por parceiros, órgãos reguladores, associações comerciais, entre outros.  Obedecer aos procedimentos e políticas internas e contribuir positivamente para o clima organizacional e objetivos do negócio com respeito à aspectos de qualidade, segurança, meio ambiente e sustentabilidade, diversidade & inclusão e custos.  Possuir disponibilidade para viagens e atuação em diferentes fábricas / localidades conforme a necessidade do negócio    Qualificações  Trabalhar na JDE Peet’s é colocar a mão na massa, com a oportunidade de deixar sua marca enquanto atuamos juntos como um só time. Somos uma empresa dinâmica, com propósito e foco no que realmente importa. Nosso ambiente exige energia, agilidade e ousadia. Se você está pronto(a) para gerar impacto e crescer em um time global, a JDE Peet’s é o seu lugar. Para esta posição, buscamos alguém com as seguintes habilidades e experiências:   Superior completo em áreas relacionadas à Tecnologia de Alimentos, em Engenharia (Alimentos, Bioprocessos e Biotecnologia, Química e correlatos), Química, Biologia ou Ciências de Alimentos.  Inglês em nível intermediário considerando que o reporte da área é para equipe global, as interações são frequentes, escrita e falada.  Desejável:  conhecimento em legislação de produtos lácteos (MAPA/ ANVISA), Produtos em pó, suplementos alimentares.    Informações adicionais  Contamos com um programa de benefícios flexíveis em que você poderá personalizar seus benefícios de acordo com seu momento e estilo de vida.   Assistência Médica;  Assistência Odontológica;  Previdência Privada;  Vale Alimentação;  Desconto de Produtos;  Programa Grãos do Futuro (assistência e licença estendida para famílias gestantes e adotantes)  Plano de Saúde Pet;    Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão   Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.  Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.  Nossos esforços nessa agenda nos renderam o prestigioso Prêmio Catalyst e a Certificação Fair Pay Leader 2025, reconhecimento pelo nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial, refletido em uma diferença de gênero global de apenas 0,52%.  #DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis  Descrição da empresa  Quem somos nós?   Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.  A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.  Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.  No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.  Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?   Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café.Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade. Na JDE Peet’s, trabalharemos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global.  Venha fazer parte do nosso time e descubra qual é a sua xícara de momentos incríveis!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nova oportunidade para Business Manager - Kings League Americas/Brazil em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT THE KINGS LEAGUE  Created and organized by Kosmos, the Kings League has become a global phenomenon that has revolutionized the way we understand football and sports. A new 7-a-side football league with teams chaired by the world's best streamers and content creators, with revolutionary rules aimed at uniting the best of football with the latest trends in esports and new ways of communicating and understanding the world. In this sense, the Kings League has not only managed to "reimagine the game," but has also elevated sport and entertainment to a new dimension, making it more accessible to all audiences.  ABOUT THE ROLE  The regional Franchise Business Manager is a key partner to Kings League franchises (teams and sublicensees). You’ll work directly with franchises to build sustainable, professional, and profitable businesses, while aligning Kings League’s brand, product, and operational standards.  You’ll shape a new model of football entertainment through a creator-led, digital-first league that is redefining fan engagement. You’ll have real ownership and impact, managing a region and directly influencing revenue potential, business strategy, and profitability for Kings League franchises.  The position combines strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, providing exposure to senior leaders, athletes, creators, and global brand partners, all within a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment where ideas move quickly from concept to reality. It’s a unique opportunity to learn, lead, and innovate while helping scale a truly global sports and entertainment ecosystem.  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   Serve as the primary business contact for assigned Kings League franchises, working closely with club presidents and management teams.  Lead regular business reviews (bi‑weekly, monthly, quarterly) to track performance and drive accountability.  Support franchise commercial strategy, including sponsorship packages, pricing, targets, forecasts, and sales materials.  Proactively identify new revenue opportunities for franchises, in line with Kings League’s global strategy.  Monitor and analyze KPIs across revenue, digital/media performance, costs, and profitability, identifying risks and upside opportunities.  Support budgeting, financial planning, and profit optimization initiatives.  Identify and facilitate strategic introductions between franchises and relevant investors, sponsors, and ecosystem partners, in coordination with Kings League leadership.  Support franchise content, marketing, and fan engagement strategies working cross‑functionally with Kings League’s global, digital‑first model.  Coordinate closely with internal commercial, marketing, finance, content, and operations teams to ensure alignment, execution, and follow‑through.  Facilitate workshops and best‑practice sharing across the Kings League ecosystem.    QUALIFICATIONS   5+ years of experience in consulting, operations, finance, corporate development, strategy, or strategic commercial roles.  Strong business orientation with proven analytical and financial acumen (budgeting, P&L analysis, forecasting).  Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.  Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, entrepreneurial environment.  Strong understanding of digital media, content‑driven brands, or sports/entertainment ecosystems preferred.  Fluency in English, Portuguese & Spanish.  Ability to work effectively across departments, regions, cultures, and time zones.    DIVERSITY & INCLUSION COMMITMENT  At Kings League we strongly believe in building an inclusive and diverse work environment, where everyone can develop their full potential. We are committed to integrating people with any profile, independently of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, origin and/or disability status, and fostering a team where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow. If you meet the requirements of the position, we invite you to send us your application; we value the richness that diversity brings and look forward to welcoming your talent and experience.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior CRO Specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior CRO Specialist em montenegro. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us  Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer‑led products, and we’re always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:   About The Role  Ruby Labs is looking for a CRO Manager – someone who lives and breathes conversion optimization and delivers measurable results. In this role, you’ll have a clear mission: deliver 15% conversion rate growth in a quarter. Unlike companies where CRO specialists simply make recommendations, you’ll drive the entire process: from data analysis and hypothesis generation to creating high‑fidelity mockups, collaborating with developers on implementation, and ultimately owning the performance outcomes. At Ruby Labs, we’ve built a compensation structure that directly rewards those who exceed targets – top performers see substantial financial growth tied directly to their impact. If you’re ready to apply your optimization talents in an environment where excellence is expected and rewarded, we want to talk to you.  Key Responsibilities   Lead end‑to‑end optimization cycles: research → hypothesis → design → testing → rollout.  Conduct in‑depth funnel analysis and competitive benchmarking to identify high‑impact opportunities.  Design high‑quality UI/UX mockups that clearly communicate your vision and maintain brand integrity.  Partner with engineers to ensure flawless test implementation and deployment.  Maintain uncompromising attention to detail and quality throughout the process.  Analyze test outcomes with statistical rigor, making confident scaling decisions.  Document learnings and build a systematic testing roadmap for continuous conversion growth.  Present insights and results clearly to stakeholders, building alignment and momentum.    Qualifications   Proven CRO Results: 3+ years of hands‑on CRO experience, ideally with subscription or SaaS funnels, with documented performance lifts.  Design Sensibility: Strong UI/UX understanding, able to create compelling, detailed mockups.  Analytical Expertise: Skilled in platforms such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Growthbook (or similar).  Execution Excellence: Remarkable attention to detail with a bias for action in fast‑moving environments.  Ownership Mentality: Self‑driven, proactive, and comfortable being fully accountable for performance outcomes.  Communication: Clear, persuasive communicator with strong English skills (written and spoken).  Fluent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills.    Nice to have   Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar).  Exposure to marketing attribution models, UTM parameters, and ROAS measurement.  Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and execute quickly.  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.    What we offer to High Performers   A merit‑based environment where performance directly impacts compensation.  Substantial bonus structure tied to exceeding KPI targets.  Rapid career advancement for those who consistently deliver.  Autonomy to implement your vision without bureaucratic barriers.  Opportunity to work with a team that moves fast and values excellence.    Location  Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.  Benefits   Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work‑life balance.  Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well‑being, without counting days.  Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.  Company‑provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top‑notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.  Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:     Interview Process   Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)  Home Task Assignment  First Interview (60 minutes)  Final Interview (45 minutes)    Life at Ruby Labs  At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small – we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more – more responsibility, more growth, and more success.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

We achieve this by building and operating the world’s leading data and AI infrastructure platform, enabling our customers to leverage deep data insights and enhance their business. And we’re only getting started.  As a Technical Escalation Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating efforts to resolve critical customer issues, customer‑impacting situations, and major incidents. You will work with multiple internal teams (engineering, product management, Customer Success Engineering, and Support) and external partners to effectively resolve these customer‑impacting situations.  The impact you will have here:    Manage support escalation in partnership with engineering, product management, Customer Success Engineering, Support, Customers, and Partners until resolution.  Achieve customer satisfaction by ensuring incidents or escalations (and related cases) are well and fully documented with the timely execution of action items.  Create and execute a data‑driven customer recovery plan for every escalation and incident that is addressed.  Utilize business and technical skills to manage customer escalations, coordinate meetings and deliverables, and analyze trends and patterns for reporting purposes.  Use data, metrics, and feedback to inform operational and tactical decisions that improve incident and escalation management.  Coordinate all necessary resources to fast‑track and resolve new incidents and escalations from customers with a clear and detailed plan.    What are we looking for?    A minimum of 5 years of experience in customer support, escalation, SRE, or incident management is required.  Excellent contextual interpretation and writing skills, as well as the ability to effectively summarize and communicate to both technical and business audiences.  Experience with a "Distributed big data Computing" environment, SQL‑based databases, as well as data warehousing and ETL technologies such as Informatica, DataStage, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, and MySQL.  Linux/Unix administration skills, networking, and hands‑on Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP are required.  Experience working cross‑functionally with support, engineering, product management, and directly with customers; ability to deeply understand product and customer personas.  BS or Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or related Engineering field.    About Databricks   Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes:   Experiência com análise forense (ex: FTK, Volatility) e gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades (ex: Nessus, Qualys);  Familiaridade com soluções de DLP, UEBA, firewalls NGFW, e-mail security, CASB e SSPM. About the Role   As a Senior Data Engineer, you will manage the "discovery-to-scale" pipeline, identifying recurring patterns in the field and handing off validated solutions to Platform Engineers for enterprise generalization. In this forward-deployed role, you will bridge the gap between building technical products and solving real-world business problems through rapid solution delivery and deep domain immersion. Your primary objective is to design and build data integration, storage systems, and infrastructure that enable analytics and AI capabilities.  This role requires high-level autonomy, where you will define your own direction within strategic goals, influence multiple teams, and navigate high complexity and ambiguity to deliver tangible business results.  What we are looking for    Experience & Education:  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering with 8–12 years of relevant experience leading and delivering complex data engineering projects with multi-team or business impact.  Enterprise Data Integration & Architecture:  Proven expertise in designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT). Must demonstrate the ability to navigate complex enterprise data landscapes, effectively handle undocumented schemas, and implement resilient integration solutions for high-volume data.  Cloud-Native Data Ecosystems:  Deep expertise in deploying and managing data infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and establishing end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for data solutions.  Advanced Data Modeling:  Strong skills in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, with the ability to balance data normalization, query performance, and safely manage complex schema migrations in production.  AI/MLOps Readiness:  Mastery of incorporating AI tools to optimize data engineering workflows and the ability to design data validation and evaluation frameworks that support the deployment and governance of AI/ML models.  Full-Stack Solution Delivery:  Capability to rapidly prototype and build complete, end-to-end data applications across diverse technology stacks, prioritizing solution speed and business value while effectively managing technical debt.  System Reliability & Resilience (SRE):  Direct experience defining and monitoring service level objectives (SLOs/SLIs). A track record of designing highly resilient data systems that ensure graceful degradation and driving post-incident improvements.  Architectural Leadership:  Ability to make sound architectural trade-offs, design scalable system components, and produce high-quality, well-tested code that adheres to enterprise standards.    Who you are    Polymath Oriented:  You bridge gaps between engineering, design, business, and science, rapidly immersing yourself in new domains to speak the language of the business.  Curious Explorer:  You seek out ambiguity rather than avoiding it, driving team curiosity through challenging questions and creating an environment that encourages experimentation.  Outcome Owner:  You drive an accountability culture focused on business impact rather than just deliverables, owning relationships and making trade-offs between custom solutions and generalizable work.  Systems Thinker:  You map complex system interactions across technical and business domains, anticipating cascading effects and understanding how technology changes impact operations.  Precise Communicator:  You translate seamlessly between technical and business language, ensuring requirements are clear enough to enable AI generation and facilitate productive discussions with stakeholders.  Problem Discoverer:  You embed with users to discover latent needs, turning ambiguity into clear problem statements rather than waiting for defined tasks.    What Appnovation Offers    Challenging and rewarding work with real impact  Direct Access to Cutting-Edge AI Platforms  Diverse and Inclusive Culture  Growth opportunities for personal and professional development  A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued  Exposure to exciting projects and high-profile clients  Supportive work environment with access to company leaders    Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Coordenar a equipe técnica para agendar testes e garantir que os procedimentos adequados sejam seguidos.  Gerenciar contas de clientes e manter registros atualizados. Supervisar/liderar equipe, fornecendo instruções e feedback sobre os procedimentos, protocolos, rotinas, instruções da diretoria e de treinamentos/reuniões diversos.  Cumprir com as leis e regulamentos federais, estaduais e locais aplicáveis em relação às operações de laboratório.  Garantir a organização de todo o ambiente de trabalho, desde rotinas de limpeza, manutenção de equipamentos, funcionamento da unidade e rotinas diversas.  Possuir habilidades de liderança para gerenciar sua equipe, o que inclui delegar tarefas, fornecer feedback e motivar os funcionários a seguir os protocolos de segurança e manter a limpeza do laboratório. Habilidades de resolução de problemas: identificar e resolver problemas que ocorrem no laboratório e solucionar problemas de equipamentos/dia-a-dia. Job description  Cremer  - uma empresa Viveo.   Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!   A Cremer, , fundada em 1935, é a maior empresa do Brasil no fornecimento de produtos de primeiros socorros, cirurgia, tratamento, higiene e proteção. Trabalhamos firmes para atingir a meta de estar presente em todos os lares e hospitais do Brasil, cuidando de nossos consumidores em todas as fases da vida, para ser a marca mais lembrada do mercado da saúde.  A Cremer faz parte da Viveo, um ecossistema especialista em cuidados que olha para cada vida de maneira única, conectando todos os elos da cadeia para simplificar o setor da saúde. Com capital 100% nacional, consolidada como a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Oferece soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras na fabricação de materiais e distribuição de materiais e medicamentos a hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e pacientes.  Com mais de 50 unidades e 6.500 colaboradores diretos, nosso propósito é cuidar de cada vida. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.  Saiba mais em:  e   Main responsibilities   Experiência na operação de empilhadeira;  Desejável vivência na operação de trator de pequeno porte, para apoio na movimentação de materiais;  Responsável pela limpeza e organização da área, incluindo a retirada e descarte adequado de resíduos, conforme normas da empresa;  Executar demais atividades pertinentes à função.    Requirements and skills   Ensino médio completo;  Curso de Operador de Empilhadeira (conforme NR-11);  Desejável experiência prévia em ambiente fabril;  Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos.    Additional information  Benefícios - Cuidar faz parte de quem somos:   Plano de saúde - cuidando do que mais importa: sua saúde;  Plano odontológico - cuidar do sorriso também faz parte;  Refeitório na empresa - praticidade e qualidade no seu dia a dia;  Vale transporte - para seu deslocamento com tranquilidade;  Seguro de vida - segurança e proteção para você e sua família;  Previdência Privada - ajudando você a planejar seu futuro;  PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados;  Centro de Saúde Viveo - acesso prático a diversas especialidades presenciais e também em uma plataforma online;  Desconto nos produtos da loja física da Cremer;  Descontos exclusivos na loja Mafra Especialidades;  Total Pass - para cuidar e movimentar o corpo;  Parcerias e descontos exclusivos para colaboradores - para estudos, lazer e muito mais. Afinidade e desejo de aprender e aplicar uma nova gama de habilidades, especialmente em marketing e vendas. Conectado(a) com diversos grupos e indivíduos influentes no campus. title: [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí
description:
Nova oportunidade para [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí em santos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí  El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu  y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno. El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos. La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés  ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción. Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio. El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia  y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3)  a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua  en una batida de limpieza ciudadana. El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural. La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Brazil Business Development Manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Brazil Business Development Manager em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Khan Academy is a fast‑paced nonprofit with a mission to provide a free, world‑class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers high‑quality, supplemental content and practice—free of charge—covering core academic subjects from Pre‑K through 12th grade and early college, with a strong focus on math and science. We serve over 200 million registered learners across 190 countries and 55 languages, and we are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, especially those in historically under‑resourced communities. For more information, please see research findings about Khan Academy and our press center.  OUR COMMUNITY  Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, education, big tech companies, and startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.  KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL  Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.  ABOUT THE ROLE  Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.  Your key responsibilities  Strategic growth   Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities  Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts  Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies  Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management    Public‑sector pipeline and bids   Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities  Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models  Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:  Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts  Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas  Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria  Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation  Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners    Implementation and impact   Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators  Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections  Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices    Stakeholder and relationship building   Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy  When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts  Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams    ABOUT YOU  What you bring   10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies  At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes  Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector  Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously  Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority  Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts  Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams  Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions  Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail  Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments  Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil  Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages    You would be a great fit if you have   Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators  Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities  Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)  Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes  Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback  Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education    What is nice to have   Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation  First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization    PERKS AND BENEFITS  We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:   Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits  Flexible schedules and generous time off, including personal days beyond standard vacation  A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning  An exceptional team that trusts you, supports you, and gives you autonomy to do your best work  The opportunity to apply your talents to a meaningful mission, contributing to high‑impact offerings that are shaping the future of education  A kind, inclusive, and welcoming workplace, with affinity groups, ally networks, and social activities to help you connect and belong    Live & breathe learners  We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.  Take a stand  As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.  Embrace diverse perspectives  We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.  Work responsibly and sustainably  We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non‑profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.  Bring out the joy  We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co‑create with our teammates, partners and donors.  Cultivate learning mindset  We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.  Deliver wow  We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end‑to‑end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.  HOW TO APPLY   Attach your resume or Linkedin URL in the space provided below.  Please address the below‑mentioned task and attach your response in the space provided below.    TASK  Describe a public‑sector partnership or bid process where you played a leading role. In your answer, briefly cover:   The context and goal of the opportunity  The key actions you led (e.g., stakeholder engagement, proposal/bid work, internal alignment)  The outcome and one key learning    Please anonymize any confidential information and limit your response to one page.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
Confira a vaga para Narrative Designer | Talent Pool em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality. ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new. JOB DESCRIPTION ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER  to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process. When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience. The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project. MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES: Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product; Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools; Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems; Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience; Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.; Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements; Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests; Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks; Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.  MUST HAVE: Exceptional writing ability; Fluency in Portuguese and English; Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs; Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines; Previous experience in narrative content creation teams; Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire; Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback; Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements; Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay; Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media; Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games; Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience; Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.  NICE TO HAVE: Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software; Previous experience with VR and AR content; Experience working in a studio or production company; Video game industry experience; A passion for Virtual Reality.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:
